Class PiratesCard

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsw.is25am31.model.cards.Card
it.polimi.ingsw.is25am31.model.cards.PiratesCard
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable
public class PiratesCard extends Card
The PiratesCard class represents a card in the game that introduces a pirate encounter. When this card is applied, the player either wins the encounter and gains resources or loses and receives penalties.
